Taylor (product): Quick sync — customer A (finance) pushed back: they need cost breakdown per-route + trace hooks for latency spikes before GA. We have to decide MVP scope for next sprint. Thoughts? :thinking:
Maria C.: Are we talking full per-route token cost in UI or just sampling + hotspot list?
Taylor (product): Minimal ask = per-route cost rollup (daily) + top 5 traces for errors/latency. No deep per-token breakdown yet.
Ajay S.: For top 5 traces we need trace sampling hooks + short retention. Implementing tracing hooks will add ~3 sprint-days infra work (ingest + UI). Sampling can be bounded to 1% by default.
Kevin L. (SE): From customer conversations they want fast signal — a daily email + UI. They don't need full trace detail, just span names and latency percentiles. Could we provide a lightweight trace summary endpoint instead of full traces?
Maria C.: That could cut work. Summary endpoint = aggregated spans + p50/p95 + top slow endpoints. No trace rendering. UI is simpler (table + link to raw trace if available). Query we'll expose: `sum(tokens) by (route)` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_latency_bucket[5m]))` for p95.
Taylor (product): So proposal: ship per-route cost (daily rollup) + trace-summary (no flamechart) in sprint. Acceptable tradeoff vs full trace UI? :eyes: 
Ajay S.: Yes, but we need a fallback plan: if tracing hook integration blocks, we ship cost rollup + sampled error alerts and mark trace-summary as alpha behind flag.
Kevin L. (SE): I'll get customer A to accept alpha flag. We should show cost vs error rate correlation in the same table.
Taylor (product): Actions: Kevin -> confirm acceptance by EOD, Maria -> mockups for table by tomorrow morning, Ajay -> dev estimate + gating risks by EOD. OpsBot: created task OBS-418 in product board. :white_check_mark:
OpsBot: Task OBS-418 created: 'mini-cost+trace-summary rollup — sprint X' — assigned to Maria C., Ajay S., Kevin L.
Taylor (product): Great — we can tighten scope in planning. Thanks everyone :tada:
